findings.desc: done_closure can report canAttemptDone=true and authorityServerPath.required=false from local DONE oracle rows even though story_advance DONE also runs runAuthorityReceiptTransitionGate and blocks in Authority enforce mode without a verified production receipt. This under-reports the Authority Server path instead of projecting the same real DONE closure boundary; the runbook should include the Authority receipt gate status/next command and avoid canAttemptDone=true for the full DONE attempt when enforce-mode receipt consumption would fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in a0a87ceb8: done_closure now projects Authority DONE receipt readiness in enforce mode, sets authorityServerPath.required=true when required, blocks canAttemptDone without an eligible production gate_decision receipt, and remains read-only. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-preflight-smoke.js; npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-receipts; npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/done-closure.ts:121 and :129-133 compute canAttemptDone and authorityServerPath without checking Authority mode or receipt eligibility. In Authority enforce mode, packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:347-405 can still block TEST/DONE on consumeAuthorityGateReceiptDocument, so done_closure can report local blockers clear, required=false, receiptVerified=false instead of the required Authority receipt path. This violates docs/requirements/decisions/done-closure-runbook-assistant-execution-plan.md:261-287, which requires the runbook to reflect the story_advance DONE pre-check and keep receiptVerified tied to verified receipts. Severity high because the assistant can mislead agents about DONE closure in Authority mode, even though the underlying gate still blocks.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in a0a87ceb8: done_closure no longer derives full readiness from local DONE rows only. Authority enforce mode now projects receipt requirement and blocks canAttemptDone unless the existing authority receipt eligibility check accepts a production gate_decision ref for DONE. The command still does not write consumption events or claim Authority DONE. Verified by build, done-preflight smoke, authority gate receipts, authority gate consumption, and process fact contract.
